
---
title: "Teaching"
---

I view teaching and learning as fundamentally human endeavors.
My goal is to create a classroom in which students feel
comfortable exploring unfamiliar ideas while developing the
precision and rigor needed to do mathematics independently. 

I aim to connect abstract mathematical concepts to geometric
intuition, concrete examples, and visual representations
whenever possible.

For
a full essay on my instructional approach, here is my [teaching philosophy statement](/files/Teaching_Statement-4.pdf).

## Teaching experience

My teaching experience includes calculus, multivariable
calculus, and differential equations, both as a teaching
assistant and as an instructor of record.

As an instructor, I have designed course materials,
assignments, and computational demonstrations to help
students connect mathematical theory with applications.
